name: wappie
description: Access to your WhatsApp archive in Wappie through its attested reader: metadata by default, and message text, attachments, drafts you review in the Wappie console and notes to your own chat only with your consent.

interface.shortDescription: Metadata by default, content by consent
interface.longDescription: Wappie archives the WhatsApp numbers you connect to it and stores their content encrypted. This plugin connects your assistant to Wappie's attested reader, which runs a published image in an AWS Nitro Enclave; your browser checks that image before it seals anything to it. When you sign in to the Wappie console you choose which numbers the assistant may read. By default it sees metadata: who, when, how much and what type of message, not the content. Where Wappie has enabled them for your workspace, you can also allow, with your password: message text and names, and attachments, opened inside the enclave; drafts that you review and confirm yourself in the Wappie console; and notes to your own chat. Voice notes, audio and video are transcribed only where you set up an AI integration with your own provider key. Nothing the assistant drafts reaches anyone until you confirm it, and it cannot delete or edit your messages or mark them as read. You can revoke the connection in the console at any time. Wappie is an independent product of The Happie Co and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.
